ns2:course.label: Introduction to Costume Design
ns2:course.description: Introduces the principles and terminology used in the process of designing costumes for the stage. Class assignments will develop skills in costume design and focus on specific elements of design, variety, characterization, and stylization. Assignments and projects will emphasize different aspects of costume design, focusing on research, character exploration and visual concept, as well as learning practical aspects of production: use of fabric and crafts, costume construction, paper work, and effective communication skills in design presentations.
